items.title: Implement remaining live adapters
items.detail: Five adapters (LIFULL HOME'S Akiya Bank, at-home commercial, HOME'S, Rakumachi, Nifty My Home) currently document their selectors but inherit fixture-only loading. Implement fetch_live() per portal so coverage extends beyond the two working scrapers (at-home Akiya Bank + SUUMO).

items.title: Municipal akiya-bank crawler
items.detail: MunicipalNaganoAdapter is a placeholder. Build a config-driven sub-portal crawler for the 1,000+ fragmented municipal akiya banks, mapped by town — the long-tail source national portals miss. Schema already supports source_type='municipal'.

items.title: Pagination beyond page 1
items.detail: Both live scrapers currently take page 1 (at-home) / page 1 + up to 3 city pages (SUUMO) per prefecture. Add polite pagination so deep inventory in a target prefecture is fully captured, not just the first page.

items.title: Per-listing hazard exposure
items.detail: The listings.hazard_json column is reserved but unpopulated. Cross-reference each geocoded listing against the MLIT hazard tiles (already on the map) to attach flood/landslide/tsunami risk to the listing itself, then make it a Profile filter.

items.title: Property tax population
items.detail: property_tax_jpy exists in the schema but is rarely sourced. Estimate or scrape fixed-asset tax so total cost of ownership (price + tax + renovation estimate) is shown per listing.

items.title: Smarter renovation estimates
items.detail: estimate_reno() is a flat per-sqm heuristic by type. Refine with build year, current_status spec (現況), and structure (wood vs RC) for a more credible budget.

items.title: City-level map GeoJSON
items.detail: The map zooms to a prefecture on city selection but has no municipal boundaries. Add city-level GeoJSON so the drill-down renders true municipality choropleths.

items.title: DeepL as primary engine
items.detail: All 187 cached translations currently come from the local Ollama fallback. Wire a DEEPL_API_KEY so the auto chain uses DeepL first for higher-fidelity agent-remark and structural-defect translation.

items.title: Translate descriptions in bulk
items.detail: Descriptions are translated lazily on listing open to keep ingest fast. Add an optional background pass to pre-translate descriptions for matched listings so digests read fully in English.

items.title: QI_AkiyaScout NSSM service + tunnel
items.detail: Register a QI_AkiyaScout NSSM service (prefix QI_, AppDirectory C:\APPS\AkiyaScout, main.py, set Description) plus a QI_AkiyaScoutTunnel, and add both to C:\QIH\ecosystem\QI_Service_Registry.md so the Scout runs 24/7 instead of via Start_AkiyaScout.bat.

items.title: QI Brain logging
items.detail: Log Scout cycles, ingest stats, and significant decisions to the QI Brain (qi.log_session / qi.log_decision) for cross-project memory. integrates_with is currently empty in the registry.

items.title: QI Standards compliance audit
items.detail: Run qi_validator.py --project akiyascout. Reconcile the legacy C:\APPS\QI\ECOSYSTEM CORS import path in api/main.py with the migrated C:\QIH\ecosystem location, and confirm the 7-folder QI layout.

items.title: Saved-listing favorites & notes
items.detail: Let the user bookmark listings and attach private notes per property, surfaced in a shortlist view alongside matches.

items.title: Days-on-market & price-drop tracking
items.detail: listed_date is captured; track how long a listing has been live and flag price reductions across re-ingests to spot motivated sellers.

items.title: Profile wizard UX
items.detail: Replace raw criteria editing with a guided step-by-step onboarding wizard (the original product-spec vision) that captures goals into criteria_json without exposing JSON.
